ayahOccurrences.text: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا

ayahOccurrences.text: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine singular (form III) imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تُخَافِتْ is in the derivative form: تُخَافِتُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
خ/ف/ت   kh–f–t weakness caused by hunger, to become feeble
; to become inaudible, to die down, to become soft, (of voice) to become subdued, to become still, to die suddenly.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 3 times in the Qur’an:
تُخَافِتُ tukhāfit 1 time; and يَتَخَافَتُ yatakhāfat 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تُخَافِتُ tukhāfit [imperf. of v. III خَافَتَ khāfata, intrans.] to endeavour to muffle one’s voice, to keep one’s voice inaudible

(17:110) وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ سَبِيلا and do not be loud in your prayer, or too quiet, but seek between these [lit. this] a way.

entries.label: تُخَافِتُ
entries.definitionHtml:
تُخَافِتُ tukhāfit [imperf. of v. III خَافَتَ khāfata, intrans.] to endeavour to muffle one’s voice, to keep one’s voice inaudible

(17:110) وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ سَبِيلا and do not be loud in your prayer, or too quiet, but seek between these [lit. this] a way.

entries.label: يَتَخَافَتُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يَتَخَافَتُ yatakhāfat [imperf. of v. VI تَخَافَتَ takhāfata, intrans.] to enjoin quietness on one another, to hold an exchange in low voices, to whisper

(68:23) فَانْطَلَقُوا وَهُمْ يَتَخَافَتُونَ so they went off, speaking to each other in whispers.
